title: South Korea's Voice-Phishing Ring: 46 Arrested, 9.4 Billion Won Stolen

segments.text: Breaking: 46 men sentenced for a $6.8 million voice‑phishing ring.
$6.8 million vanished in a single phone call. How did 46 men pull it off?
The scam ring operated from Cambodia and Thailand, targeting South Korean victims from June 2024 to July 2025, defrauding roughly 110 people of about 9.4 billion Korean won (~$6.8 million).

Forty‑six defendants were charged with fraud, concealment of criminal proceeds, and participation in a criminal organization. The ring leader, known as 'Bugeon'—a Chinese national whose real identity is not publicly disclosed—was also implicated. In April 2026, the Daejeon District Court's Hongseong branch sentenced the defendants to terms ranging from one year and eight months to ten years in prison.
If you’ve received a suspicious call, report it to 112 or your local police. Remember, a single phone call can cost millions—stay vigilant.
